release_notes:
• Seeking a streaming song is fast again: a far scrub rebuilds the stream at the position you released, sound resumes in about a second instead of after a full download — nearby seeks stay instant
• If the rebuilt stream stays silent, the download route takes over automatically at your position, so a seek always ends with sound where you put it
• The credit & welcome page can no longer come back: a durable launch marker is stamped at first start, so even swiping the app away from recents right after it appears cannot show it again
• The spectrum analyser is removed from the player
